mapper.sql: create_time, update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, team_id, task_id, process_id, user_id
mapper.select:
SELECT cp.id 'project.id', cp.serial_number 'project.serialNumber', cp.NAME 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', assist.process_id, IFNULL(sum(assist.quantity),0) as 'quantity', IFNULL(sum(assist.produce_quantity),0) produceQuantity FROM mes_building_assist assist LEFT JOIN mes_building_task_process pro ON assist.task_process_id = pro.id # LEFT JOIN(select task_process_id,sum(inspection_quantity) inspection_quantity # from mes_building_produce_team_report where bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY task_process_id ) report # ON pro.id = report.task_process_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_groups_team_link link ON assist.groups_id = link.groups_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link teamlink ON link.team_id = teamlink.team_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_team team ON teamlink.team_id = team.id AND team.process_id = pro.process_id LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON pro.project_id = cp.id WHERE pro.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND link.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND teamlink.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND team.bool_delete_enum = 0 and pro.process_id = #{processId} and teamlink.user_id = #{userId} and assist.quantity != assist.produce_quantity
AND cp.short_name like concat('%',#{projectName},'%') or AND cp.name like concat('%',#{projectName},'%')
GROUP BY cp.id, cp.serial_number, cp.NAME, cp.short_name, assist.process_id

SELECT cp.id 'project.id', cp.serial_number 'project.serialNumber', cp.NAME 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', assist.process_id, COUNT(distinct detail.number) AS quantity, IFNULL(sum(assist.produce_quantity),0) produceQuantity FROM mes_building_assist assist LEFT JOIN mes_building_task_process pro ON assist.task_process_id = pro.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_assist_number_detail detail on detail.task_process_id = pro.id and detail.bool_delete_enum =0 and detail.bool_finish_enum =0 and detail.assist_id = assist.id
INNER JOIN mes_building_task_number_link link ON link.artifact_task_process_id = detail.task_process_id and link.bool_artifact_report = false and link.bool_delete_enum = 0 and link.artifact_number = detail.number
INNER JOIN mes_building_task_number_link link ON link.assemble_task_process_id = detail.task_process_id and link.bool_assemble_report = false and link.bool_delete_enum = 0 and link.assemble_number = detail.number
LEFT JOIN mes_building_team team ON assist.team_id = team.id AND team.process_id = pro.process_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link teamlink ON team.id = teamlink.team_id LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON pro.project_id = cp.id WHERE pro.bool_delete_enum = 0 and assist.bool_delete_enum =0 AND team.bool_delete_enum = 0 and pro.process_id = #{processId} and pro.task_type_enum = #{taskTypeEnum} and teamlink.user_id = #{userId} and assist.quantity != assist.produce_quantity
AND cp.short_name like concat('%',#{projectName},'%') or AND cp.name like concat('%',#{projectName},'%')
GROUP BY cp.id, cp.serial_number, cp.NAME, cp.short_name, assist.process_id
